            Person.id.in_(random_ids)).all()

        'index.html', persons=persons, error=error)

    current_guest_count = db.session.query(Person).count()

    else:
        people_ids = [i[0] for i in db.session.query(Person.id)]
        selected_people_ids = set()
        while len(selected_people_ids) < MAX_GUESTS:
            random_id = random.choice(people_ids)
            selected_people_ids.add(random_id)
        selected_people = Person.query.filter(
            Person.id.in_(selected_people_ids)
        ).all()
        persons = []
        map(persons.append, selected_people)
    return render_template(
        'index.html', persons=persons, error=error)
